C0082.title: Nanjing Police Dismantle Ground Promotion Flyer Ring Serving Overseas Telecom Fraud Compounds
C0082.summary: In June 2025, Jiangsu police reported a special campaign against illegal flyer-based traffic diversion. Nanjing police expanded a patrol lead and identified a criminal group that promoted small ads for overseas telecom-fraud compounds. In late May, officers carried out arrests across multiple locations and detained 15 suspects. Victims scanned QR codes on cards, entered fake online prostitution pages, and were then induced into recharge and task-fraud schemes.
